video.title: AI欧腐《我教人鱼求偶，结果怀了他的蛋/I Taught a Siren to Court, Now I'm Carrying His Egg》
video.desc:
For his thesis, Evan discovers Ebonni, a mysterious deep-sea merman. While teaching Ebonni a courtship dance, Evan accidentally makes him think he’s being courted. Ebonni claims Evan as his mate—and soon, Evan discovers he’s pregnant with a merman’s child.
为了完成毕业论文，Evan 发现了神秘的深海人鱼 Ebonni。在教 Ebonni 跳求偶舞的过程中，Evan 无意间让他误以为自己正在被求爱。Ebonni 就此认定 Evan 是他的伴侣，而没过多久，Evan 发现自己竟然怀上了人鱼的孩子。
